issue: Consumer rights, defects in goods, deficiency in services, and consumer dispute redressal.
outcome: Consumer Protection Act, 2019. Reference: Act No. 35 of 2019. Covers consumer rights and remedies, including Sections 2(9), 35 and 39.

issue: Consumer protection responsibilities and unfair trade practices in online shopping.
outcome: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020. Official Gazette notification G.S.R. 462(E), dated 23 July 2020.

issue: Dark patterns that mislead consumers or manipulate their choices on digital platforms.
outcome: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023. Official Gazette notification dated 30 November 2023. Covers prohibited dark-pattern practices and examples in Annexure I.

issue: How consumers can register and track grievances through the National Consumer Helpline.
outcome: The National Consumer Helpline is a pre-litigation grievance redressal mechanism. Consumers can register grievances online or by calling 1915 or 1800-11-4000. A unique docket number is issued.

issue: Consumer rights relating to safety, information, choice, being heard, redressal and consumer education.
outcome: The National Consumer Helpline explains the six consumer rights guaranteed under the Consumer Protection Act.
